title: Netra Server To Client Message
$comment: Only response.segment has a payload sub-schema so far. session.snapshot, quiz.question and error are still untyped here: their field sets require a coordinated M1/M4/M5 decision (notably the interaction_mode vocabulary and the representation of the last stable result set), and inventing one inside a schema would make it authoritative by accident. Consumers must keep reading those payloads as opaque objects until a sub-schema exists; see client/src/Netra.Desktop/Protocol/Dto/ServerPayloads.cs.

ResponseSegment.$comment: Transcribed from the committed example at shared/contracts/examples/server/response_segment.json and the C# record that already parses it. No field is introduced here that did not already exist in both. kind reuses the segment vocabulary from agent/v1/tutor_to_coordinator.schema.json rather than defining a second one.
